messages.en: What are you doing?
I'm eating Yangzi Ganlu.
I've been really into it lately.
No, I mean,
I'm having it for dinner,
and since it's Greek yogurt, mango, and grapefruit,
I feel less guilty about it.
Did the Badge War teaser come out~?
I'll go watch it.
Wow.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹ
Why does my voice come out so much?
This looks fun.
The scale was insane.
Seriously, if you put us in a survival game,
it's fun because we actually get into it and fight for real.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
We take it way too seriously,
that for a few minutes afterward it was genuinely awkward.
ㅎㅎ….
It was kind of like this ㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
There were some crises here and there in the middle,
and whenever that happened, I'd go,
Guys, we're on a broadcast!!!!! Broadcast!!!
like that.
Oh, and then,
I'm going to give you this.
There we go.
A photo for the first time in a while.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
It looks exactly like Yangzi Ganlu.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
But in Badge War,
the scene where we're debating
has a really strong spotlight on us,
so my face looks really fierce.
I'm a little worried ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Whatever, as long as it's fun.
I have to leave early tomorrow morning,
but it should be fun.
Right, my part in 'Replay' came out.
I went and recorded it today.
There are so many ad-libs,
and the song is honestly harder than I expected.
It wasn't easy to capture the right feel.
Try to guess my part.
Hmm~
Well, some of you got it right and some got it wrong~
It will be revealed at the concert.
Looks like we're going into intense practice again.
Fighting!

messages.ko: 지금 에어컨물 뚝뚝 떨어지는곳 바로 밑에서
messages.en: Right now, I'm sitting directly underneath a place where the air conditioner is dripping water,
and I'm eating away again.
And I looked at photos from when I had brown hair,
and I really can't do it anymore.
I need to cover it up.
I know you might be sad because blonde looked pretty,
but I think once I go brown, everyone will say I made the right choice.
Someone told Jiwoo unnie
that I was eating under the air conditioner.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
She messaged me asking what I was eating under the air conditioner.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
That almost gave me goosebumps.
Ask Jiwoo unnie why she likes me so much.
Because I'm cute?
At least she knows I'm cute!
Hmph.
Oh right, I was going to sleep early today,
but after I came back from recording earlier,
I fell asleep again while watching Hello Jadoo,
and actually woke up around 9.
Hello Jadoo actually makes me sleepy pretty easily.
It feels like falling asleep while watching TV when you're a kid.
Hey, but this is totally like being an elementary school kid on summer vacation.
That's the kind of vibe I'm going for ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Eating soy sauce egg rice made by Mom,
dozing off on the sofa,
Mom is doing the dishes,
and my older brother is spinning a top.
That's the kind of vibe.
And then when evening comes,
the whole family would

messages.ko: 인라인 타러 나가고 줄넘기나 배드민턴 치고
messages.en: go out to rollerblade, jump rope, or play badminton together.
It brings back so many memories.
What? Were you from the same era as me?
I told you, being born in '07 has a surprisingly old-school vibe.

messages.ko: 우리때는 그래도 이웃끼리 친하고 다같이 모이고
messages.en: Back then, neighbors were still close and everyone would gather together,

messages.ko: 애들 다같이 놀이터 나외서 놀고 그랬지
messages.en: and all the kids would go out and play at the playground together.
But honestly, '07 feels like the cutoff,
because if you're a 2007-liner and the oldest child, you might not really know this kind of vibe.
But if you're the youngest and grew up with older brothers and sisters,
it feels like you grew up with this kind of nostalgia.
What is this?
Am I becoming a young boomer?
I'm glad you felt it too…
I used to play Cops and Robbers and Jailbreak a lot too.
Wow wow.
I played ttakji.
Rubber ttakji.
My favorite was the Cookie Run King Black Ttakji.
You'd put in a coin,
and there were also kids who would hand out ttakji.
They'd climb to the top of the playground
and shout, "I'm throwing ttakji~~~!"
while the kids waited below.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
But there usually wasn't anything good among the ones they threw.
Like slightly fluorescent yellow Angel Cookie ttakji.
Stuff like that.

messages.ko: 그럼 하연이도 그 띠부씰 같은 거 모았었어???
messages.en: Then did you collect those sticker seals too???
I didn't collect them,
but my older brother collected Pokémon stickers
and even recently, ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.ko: 나보고 막 포켓몬 빵 빨리 먹으라고
messages.en: He'd tell me to hurry up and eat the Pokémon bread
and give me just the bread while taking the sticker.

messages.ko: 혹시 하연 누나 시대 때는 고무줄놀이나 구슬치기 이런 거했나요??
messages.en: Back in Hayeon unnie's time, did you play games like jump rope or marbles??
Not that far back…
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Now I'm going to go back to sleep.
Sleep well.
Haranghae😘😘
